title: Kvernhaug Core custom-ingredient identity V1
description: Machine-readable Core V1 patterns for ingredient identity strings (canonical master IDs vs. user-defined custom IDs). Normative document: docs/development/CORE_CUSTOM_INGREDIENT_IDENTITY_V1.md. Validates identity STRINGS only, not any recipe/brew payload shape -- .kbhrecipe/.kbhbrew are unchanged by this contract (see that document's Section 15).

kbhCustomIngredientId.description: The canonical V1 custom-ingredient ID format (Section 3): a single reserved prefix followed by a lowercase RFC 4122 UUIDv4, opaque -- no ingredient-type semantics encoded (Section 4).

legacyAppCustomIngredientId.description: App's existing custom-ingredient ID shape (modules/pantry.py:291-296), grandfathered permanently (Section 9).

legacyWebCustomIngredientId.description: Web's existing custom-ingredient ID shapes across all three of its historical namespaces (recipe-level egen_malt_*/egen_humle_*, web/js/app.js:149-152; pantry-level egen_pantry_<type>*, web/js/pantry.js:130-144), grandfathered permanently (Section 9).

legacyCustomIngredientId.description: Union of every grandfathered legacy custom-ID shape (Section 9).

customIngredientId.description: Any ID recognized as a custom (non-canonical) ingredient identity under this contract -- the new kbh-custom- format or a grandfathered legacy form (Sections 3 and 9).

canonicalMasterIngredientId.description: A canonical Core master-data ingredient ID (data/master_malt.json, master_humle_v2.json, master_gjaer_v2.json): an unprefixed lowercase snake_case slug that must never start with any reserved custom-ID prefix (Section 8's disjoint-alphabet invariant).
